desc_academy: Akademi seviyesi başına tüm araştırma sürelerini %5 hızlandırır. Research Lab seviye 2 gerektirir.
desc_armor_tech: Planlanan: Seviye başına +%5 zırh bonusu. Silah Geliştirme seviyesi 1 gerektirir.
desc_barracks: Mürettebat ve denizciler için eğitim alanları. Güçlü bir askeri varlığın ve filo mürettebatının temeli.
desc_buildtime_tech: İnşa etme ve araştırma sürelerini seviye başına %3 oranında (× 0,97^seviye) katlanarak azaltır. Sınırsız ölçeklenir ve Nano-Assembly, Command Center, Lab ve Academy ile çoğalır.
desc_command_center: Askeri ve oyun sonu binalarının kilidini açar. Nano Montaj oluşturma süresini seviye başına %25 azaltır.
desc_crystal_mine: Derin damarlardan değerli Crytite hasadı yapar. Yüksek teknolojili modüller ve araştırmalar için gereklidir.
desc_crystal_storage: Crytite için özel silolar. Büyük yüksek teknoloji projelerinin finansmanı için çok önemlidir.
desc_defense_factory: Savunma birimlerinin ve uzmanlıkların kilidini açar (birim türüne göre seviye). Kendi başına üretim yapmaz; inşa hızı ve paralel kapasite yörüngedeki tersaneden gelir.
desc_drone_tech: Ferronite ve Crytite üretimini seviye başına %3 artırır. Ferronite İyileştirme içeren yığınlar.
desc_energy_tech: Boruları, dönüştürücüleri ve reaktörleri optimize eder. Madenlerinizin enerji tüketimini seviye başına %5 azaltır. Etki her ek araştırma düzeyiyle birlikte ölçeklenir.
desc_engine_tech: Planlanan: +%2 filo hızı ve seviye başına +%2 kargo. Diğerlerinin yanı sıra Nano Montaj Kompleksinin kilidini açar.
desc_fuel_cell_plant: Filo operasyonları için Fuel Cells üretir. Enerji tüketir — depolama Fuel Cell Depo tarafından gerçekleştirilir.
desc_fuel_efficiency: Filo yakıt tüketimini seviye başına %3 azaltır. Etki, her ilave araştırma seviyesiyle birlikte süresiz olarak ölçeklenir.
desc_fuel_storage: Mağazalar Fuel Cells üretti. Kapasiteyi seviye başına 1,8 kat artırır (100.000 tabanı). Depolama teknolojisi ve Terraformer ile ölçeklenir.
desc_geothermal_nexus: Seviye başına +%3 güneş enerjisi çıkışı. Jeotermal seviye başına madenler, güneş enerjisi, yakıt hücresi tesisi ve depolama için +2 maksimum seviye.
desc_metal_mine: Gezegeninizin kabuğundan Ferronite'yi çıkarır. Daha yüksek seviyeler üretim çıktısını önemli ölçüde artırır.
desc_metal_storage: Ferronite için depolama kapasitesini genişletir ve depoların dolu olmasından kaynaklanan üretim durmalarını önler.
desc_mining_tech: İmparatorluk çapında Ferronite üretimini %10 ve Crytite üretimini seviye başına %4 artırır. Drone Optimizasyonu ile Yığınlar.
desc_nanofactory: Tüm bina inşa sürelerini seviye başına %30 azaltır. İnşaat Optimizasyonu ve Research Lab ile Yığınlar.
desc_navigation_tech: Paralel filoları genişletir ve sıçramaları kısaltır. 3/5/8/10. Seviyeler yuvaların kilidini açar; 10'dan sonraki her 3 seviyede bir başka yuva eklenir. Research Lab 3 ve Drone Optimizasyonu 2 gerektirir.
desc_orbital_shipyard: Gemiler ve yörünge savunması için üretim motoru. Gemi inşasının kilidini açar, küresel tersane kapasitesini artırır (döngü başına 3^seviye), döngü sürelerini seviye başına %10 azaltır ve birim başına etkili paralel çıktıyı ölçeklendirir; hızlı tekneler, ağır nakliyecilerden daha fazla kapasite kullanır.
desc_pe_industry_t2_mining_path: Yörünge ekstraksiyonu veya derin çekirdek – kalıcı seçim.
desc_pe_industry_t5_overdrive: Aşırı hız politikası – artan reaktör riski.
desc_planet_core_nexus: Oyun Sonu: Ferronite Maden, Crytite Çıkarıcı, Güneş Kollektörleri ve Fuel Cell Tesis için seviye başına +1 maksimum seviye (temel maksimum 50). Saklama kapakları yalnızca Geothermal Nexus aracılığıyla.
desc_radar_array: Seviye başına +2 galaksi tarama aralığı ekler (bonus hazırlanır; aktivasyon takip eder). Casusluk, araştırma görevleri aracılığıyla ayrı olarak yürütülür.
desc_research_armor_tech: Katmanlı kompozit zırh ve uyarlanabilir malzeme tasarımı, gemilerinizin hayatta kalma kabiliyetini artırır.
desc_research_drones_tech: İyileştirilmiş madencilik ve hizmet dronları çalışma süresini ve hassasiyeti en üst düzeye çıkarır. Seviye başına ekstra üretim bonusu ekler.
desc_research_engine_tech: Kriyojenik soğutmalı yüksek performanslı sürücüler, büyük filolar için itişi artırır ve enerji kayıplarını azaltır.
desc_research_fuel_efficiency: Filo yakıt tüketimini seviye başına %3 azaltır. Etki, her ilave araştırma seviyesiyle birlikte süresiz olarak ölçeklenir.
desc_research_lab: Bilimsel ilerlemenizin özü. Daha yüksek seviyeler araştırmayı hızlandırır ve yeni teknolojilerin kilidini açar.
desc_research_navigation_tech: Paralel filoları genişletir ve sıçramaları kısaltır. 3/5/8/10. Seviyeler yuvaların kilidini açar; 10'dan sonraki her 3 seviyede bir başka yuva eklenir. Research Lab 3 ve Drone Optimizasyonu 2 gerektirir.
desc_research_shield_tech: Gelişmiş kalkan jeneratörleri, modülatörler ve saha amplifikatörleri, savunmanızı yoğun ateşe karşı güçlendirir.
desc_research_weapon_tech: Gelişmiş lazer, mermi ve enerji silahları, filonuzun ateş gücünü önemli ölçüde artırır.
desc_shield_generator: Oyunun sonlarında bina oluşturma (CC seviye 4, Defense Factory seviye 2). Gezegensel kalkanlar hazırlanıyor; Savunma altında taretler inşa edin.
desc_shield_tech: Planlanan: Seviye başına +%5 kalkan bonusu. Henüz gezegen veya filo kalkanı etkisi yok.
desc_shipyard: Gemi yapımının kilidini açar. Daha yüksek seviyeler daha iyi gövde sınıflarının kilidini açar ve tersane kapasitesini artırır.
desc_solar_plant: Koloninize güç sağlamak için yıldız ışığını Aetherion enerjiye dönüştüren büyük toplayıcı diziler.
desc_storage_tech: Ferronite ve Crytite depolama kapasitesini seviye başına %25 artırır. Depolama binaları ve Terraformer içeren yığınlar.
desc_tech_armor_tech: Verbundpanzer ve uyarlanabilir Malzeme ile Steigert Durchbarkeit.
desc_tech_construction_optimization: Standart modüller ve otomasyon sayesinde inşaat ve araştırma sürelerini azaltır.
desc_tech_cryogenic_drive: Özellikle büyük filolar için daha fazla itiş gücü, daha az kayıp.
desc_tech_drone_optimization: Verbessert Ausbeute durch effizientere Bergbau- und Servicedrohnen.
desc_tech_energy_efficiency: Sistemleri optimize eder ve maden enerji kullanımını seviye başına %5 azaltır.
desc_tech_hyperspace_navigation: Daha iyi atlama vektörleri ve rota hesaplaması sayesinde uçuş sürelerini kısaltır.
desc_tech_metal_refining: Daha iyi süreçler sayesinde Ferronite üretimini seviye başına %10 artırır.
desc_tech_shield_tech: Daha güçlü alanlar, modülasyon ve amplifikatörler aracılığıyla daha sağlam kalkanlar.
desc_tech_storage: Sıkıştırma, stabilizasyon ve lojistik yoluyla depolama kapasitesini artırır.
desc_tech_weapon_tech: Modern enerji ve mermi sistemleri aracılığıyla filonun ateş gücünü artırır.
desc_terraformer: Terraformer güvenli altyapı bölgeleri oluşturur; ekstra bina yuvaları değil, kullanılabilir endüstriyel ve depolama kapasitesi. Ferronite ve Crytite depolamayı seviye başına %5 artırır. Depolama binaları ve Depolama Teknolojisi içeren yığınlar.
desc_weapon_tech: Planlanan: Savaş için seviye başına +%5 silah bonusu. Kaynak bonusu yok.

codex_genesis_ark_quick_help: The Genesis Ark is your seat of power — the heart of your empire. Build, research, and Planet Evolution begin on this world.
codex_genesis_ark_summary: Every Commander owns a **Genesis Ark** as the most important world of the empire. It is not “just a planet” — it is the seat of government, account research, shipyard, and Planet Evolution. New worlds expand your realm; none of them replaces the Ark.
codex_genesis_ark_why: Genesis Colonies is not about managing interchangeable planet slots. It is about **growing a star empire**. The Genesis Ark stays the fixed center: expansion, colonies, and specializations grow around it. The Ark's development stage helps decide which regions and Expansion Sites you can reach.
codex_genesis_ark_how_it_works:
- After registration you land on **Overview** — your empire at a glance.
- The Genesis Ark is your **homeworld** — your permanent capital.
- On the Ark you first build **production** (Ferronite, Crytite, energy), start **account research**, and later the **orbital shipyard**.
- **Planet Evolution** on the Ark unlocks new regions and Expansion Sites — not single building levels as the main progress bar.
- **Imperial Directives**, diplomacy, and Ascension stay with the Ark or empire — not on outposts.
codex_genesis_ark_discord_summary:
**Genesis Ark — capital of your empire**

The Genesis Ark is the fixed center of every star empire: government, account research, shipyard, and Planet Evolution. Expansion adds worlds — not interchangeable slots. Ark development stage unlocks regions. No colony replaces the Ark.
codex_genesis_ark_faq_0_a: Stable production on the Genesis Ark, running build and research queues — and understanding that Planet Evolution is the long-term progress path.
codex_genesis_ark_faq_1_q: Can a colony replace the Genesis Ark?
codex_genesis_ark_faq_1_a: No. Strategic Worlds are mature expansion worlds, not a second capital.
codex_genesis_ark_tip_0: Think empire, not “mine 17 → 18” — Ark development stage opens new possibilities.
codex_genesis_ark_tip_1: Account research and imperial decisions belong on the Ark; planet tech belongs to individual worlds.
codex_genesis_ark_tip_2: The Command Map visualizes your growing realm — the Ark remains the hub.
codex_planet_scope_quick_help: Genesis Colonies plays per **active world**. The header switcher sets which colony shows buildings, resources, and shipyard — account research stays empire-wide.
codex_planet_scope_summary: **Planet scope** is the context you play in: one **active world** that defaults resource display, build queue, shipyard, Trader Hub, and fleet origin. Your **empire** includes all worlds — but planet building actions always happen on the selected world.
codex_planet_scope_why: Multi-colony play needs a clear context: which mine is producing, which yard is building? Scope separates **empire-wide** systems (account research, all fleet movements) from **world-bound** ones (buildings, resource tick, shipyard).
codex_planet_scope_how_it_works:
- **Planet switcher** in the header: dropdown when you have multiple worlds.
- Switching updates resources, queues, and labels via the active-planet API.
- **Homeworld** = Genesis Ark; invalid context falls back to homeworld.
- **Planet Evolution** always shows the **active** world.
- Colonization and fleets use explicit targets; logistics moves between **your** worlds.
codex_planet_scope_discord_summary:
**Planet scope — active world vs. empire**

Building, resources, and shipyard use the **active world** (header switcher). Account research and fleet overview are empire-wide. Homeworld = Genesis Ark.
codex_planet_scope_faq_0_q: Why do my resources change after switching?
codex_planet_scope_faq_0_a: Each world has its own storage and production. The switcher changes context, not your whole empire.
codex_planet_scope_faq_1_a: Yes — active non-homeworld can be deleted; active jumps to the Genesis Ark.
codex_planet_scope_tip_0: Before upgrading, check which world is active.
codex_planet_scope_tip_1: Account research costs are paid from the active world — plan resources there.
codex_planet_scope_tip_2: Inactive colonies still build in the background; scope only affects UI context.
codex_buildings_quick_help: Buildings are the engine under Planet Evolution: Ferronite mines, Crytite extractors, energy, storage, and later shipyard and defense — all per **active world**.
codex_buildings_summary: The building system manages **infrastructure per world**: levels per building, a sequential **build queue**, costs in Ferronite and Crytite from the active planet.
codex_buildings_why: Without buildings there is no production, labs, or shipyard. In Genesis Colonies they are not the end goal — they **enable** Planet Evolution, expansion, and fleets. Energy and storage prevent production from stalling.
codex_buildings_how_it_works:
- Open **Buildings** on the active world; upgrades enqueue build jobs.
- **Resources tab:** Ferronite mine, Crytite extractor, solar plant, fuel cells, depots.
- **Research tab:** research lab and academy — required for account research.
- **Military tab:** orbital shipyard, defense factory, radar.
- **Infrastructure:** command center, shield generator, terraformer, nexus buildings.
- Many buildings have **requirements** — follow the chain (e.g. shipyard after command center).
- ROI and level tables: **Technical Data** button — not in the Codex.
codex_buildings_discord_summary:
**Buildings — infrastructure per world**

Production, labs, shipyard via build queue on the **active world**. Engine for evolution and expansion. ROI: Technical Data in UI.
codex_buildings_faq_0_a: Usually energy shortage or full Ferronite/Crytite storage.
codex_buildings_faq_1_q: Where do I build the shipyard?
codex_buildings_faq_1_a: Orbital shipyard on the world you want to launch fleets from — planet-bound.
codex_buildings_tip_0: Stabilize energy before pushing mine levels.
codex_buildings_tip_1: Expand storage early — full depots cap production.
codex_buildings_tip_2: Use short builds as fillers before going offline; long jobs for absence.
codex_research_quick_help: Account research improves your **entire empire** — energy, production, fleet speed, and combat values. Costs are paid from the **active world**.
codex_research_summary: **Account research** is **empire-wide**: one tech tree and queue, lab level across colonies as unlock gate, payment in Ferronite/Crytite from the context planet. This is **not** Planet Evolution planet tech.
codex_research_why: Research solves empire-wide bottlenecks: storage, build time, mine efficiency, fleet slots, weapons. It links economy, fleet, and combat without forcing every planet alone.
codex_research_how_it_works:
- **Research lab** (empire-wide max ≥ 1) unlocks technologies.
- Start research on the Research page; queue runs sequentially.
- Techs have **requirements** — plan chains (energy before propulsion, etc.).
- Key lines: extraction, storage, build time, navigation (fleet slots), combat tech.
- **Interstellar Expansion** (account tech) gates new worlds — see Expansion Protocol.
- Planet tech on `/planet-evolution` is **world research**, not this system.
codex_research_discord_summary:
**Account research — empire-wide technology**

One tech tree for all worlds. Costs from active planet, levels account-wide. ≠ Planet tech in Planet Evolution.
codex_research_faq_0_q: Why can't I start a tech?
codex_research_faq_0_a: Missing lab level, prerequisite tech, or insufficient Ferronite/Crytite on the active world.
codex_research_faq_1_a: Account = empire. Planet tech = selected world in Planet Evolution.
codex_research_tip_0: Research should rarely sit idle — keep it parallel to the build queue.
codex_research_tip_1: Keep a lab high on at least one world — empire-wide max counts for unlocks.
codex_research_tip_2: Use the tech tree for dependencies; prioritize bottleneck techs.
codex_resources_quick_help: Ferronite, Crytite, and fuel cells drive your empire — plus **energy** scaling production. All planet-bound with storage caps per world.
codex_resources_summary: Four visible resources: **Ferronite**, **Crytite**, **fuel cells**, and **energy** (ratio of supply to demand). Production ticks server-side; full depots stop growth.
codex_resources_why: Resources fuel daily play but are not the only goal — they power build, research, fleets, and expansion. Energy and storage are the usual bottlenecks.
codex_resources_how_it_works:
- **Ferronite / Crytite:** mines on the active world; galaxy slot and climate modify output.
- **Fuel cells:** fuel cell plant; storage only with **fuel depot** after infrastructure.
- **Energy:** solar plant supplies; mines consume — shortage reduces all production.
- **Storage:** base cap without depots; storage buildings and storage tech multiply.
- Trader Hub and scrapyard can credit **above cap** — overflow kept.
- Numbers and ROI: **Technical Data** on buildings — not here.
codex_resources_discord_summary:
**Resources — Ferronite, Crytite, fuel cells, energy**

Planet-bound with storage caps. Energy scales mine output. Trader can credit above cap.
codex_resources_faq_0_a: Full storage or energy below effective 100%.
codex_resources_tip_1: Check storage before long offline periods.
codex_resources_tip_2: Fuel cells without depot do not accumulate — plan the depot.
codex_trader_quick_help: The **Trader Hub** exchanges resources and recycles surplus — unified trader and scrapyard, daily limit per player, balances on the **active world**.
codex_trader_summary: At `/trader-hub`: **Unified Resource Trader** and **scrapyard**. Context planet for balances; **daily limit** is per Commander.
codex_trader_why: Not every world produces evenly — the hub balances Ferronite, Crytite, and fuel cells without new mechanics. Scrapyard handles excess when storage or production is skewed.
codex_trader_how_it_works:
- Open **Trader Hub** from the economy section (`/trader-hub`).
- Balances use the **active world**; **daily limit** is per Commander account-wide.
- **Unified trader:** swap Ferronite, Crytite, fuel cells — rates and remaining limit in UI.
- **Scrapyard:** recycle surplus when storage is full or production is skewed.
- Daily limit scales with empire production (formula shown in UI).
- Auction house and inventory are separate routes — not mixed into the trader panel.
- Debited and credited on the context planet; overflow rules match production.
- Rates and limits come from the server UI only.
codex_trader_discord_summary:
**Trader Hub — exchange and scrapyard**

`/trader-hub`: resource swap + scrapyard. Active world balances, daily player limit.
codex_trader_faq_0_a: Daily limit per Commander — economy rhythm and fairness.
codex_trader_tip_0: Use the hub when one resource stacks and another is short.
codex_trader_tip_1: Remember the daily limit when planning big upgrades.
codex_planet_evolution_quick_help: Planet Evolution is the heart of your empire. Develop worlds through DNA, development stage, and specialization — and unlock new regions.
codex_planet_evolution_summary: **Planet Evolution** is **per-world progression**: DNA, traits, development stage/XP, planet class, planet tech (≠ account research), specialization, policies, events, discoveries, and trade routes.
codex_planet_evolution_why: Genesis differs through **identity per world** — not only building levels. Evolution decides reachable regions, specializations, and how worlds fit the empire. Buildings and account research are the engine **below** this layer.
codex_planet_evolution_how_it_works:
- Open **Planet Evolution** for the **active world**.
- **DNA & traits** shape research, events, and specialization options.
- **Genesis Ark development stage** unlocks Expansion Sites.
- Higher development: **specialization** (permanent), **policies**, narrative **events**.
- **Planet tech** — research for this world only.
- **Trade routes** link colonies to the empire visually.
- **Ascension** — separate long-term path (see Ascension article).
- Planet tech and Ascension queues show in their cards.
codex_planet_evolution_discord_summary:
**Planet Evolution — identity and progress per world**

DNA, development stage, specialization, events, planet tech. Center on Genesis Ark. ≠ Account research.
codex_planet_evolution_faq_0_q: Why is my world different from the Ark?
codex_planet_evolution_faq_0_a: Each world has its own DNA, traits, and optional specialization.
codex_planet_evolution_faq_1_a: World-bound research in Planet Evolution — not the account tech tree.
codex_planet_evolution_tip_0: Raise Ark stage before blind mine pushing — it opens the Command Map.
codex_planet_evolution_tip_1: Specialization is permanent — read the Codex before choosing.
codex_planet_evolution_tip_2: Do not confuse planet tech with account research.
codex_ascension_summary: **Ascension** is long-term progress on the Genesis Ark — a queue that prepares endgame empire growth through Planet Evolution.
codex_ascension_why: Ascension bundles endgame decisions at the **imperial capital** — consistent with the Ark never being replaced by colonies. It complements specialization and Strategic Worlds.
codex_ascension_how_it_works:
- Reachable via **Planet Evolution** on the Genesis Ark when unlocked (development stage 15).
- Jobs run in the **Ascension queue** — own card beside planet tech, sequential like other queues.
- Steps are **long-term investments**: costs and duration in UI; numbers are server-only.
- Requires prepared evolution (specialization, policies, stable Ark) — not early game.
- Complements Strategic Worlds and Imperial Directives — not a substitute for colony buildout.
- Coordinate queue time with planet tech and build jobs on the Ark.
- Per-step details: Planet Evolution UI and queue cards — not in this Codex article.
codex_ascension_discord_summary:
**Ascension — long-term on the Genesis Ark**

Queue-based endgame path in Planet Evolution at the capital.
codex_ascension_faq_0_a: Design focus is the Genesis Ark — check unlock on the active world in UI.
codex_ascension_tip_0: Plan Ascension when core evolution and empire are stable.
codex_ascension_tip_1: Coordinate queue time with other planet jobs.
codex_expansion_quick_help: Expansion is not unlocking a planet slot. **Worlds are born** — from Expansion Site through Seed Ark and Frontier Outpost to a full colony.
codex_expansion_summary: The **Expansion Protocol** turns unknown space into your empire: **Expansion Sites** on the Command Map, claims, Seed Ark transport, **Frontier Outpost**, milestone establishment, then **colony** and optional **Strategic World**. A **colony** exists only after establishment — before that it is an outpost.
codex_expansion_why: Genesis avoids spreadsheet expansion. It is a **process**: places with promise and risk become character worlds with their own DNA — not instant full copies of the Ark.
codex_expansion_how_it_works:
**Lifecycle:**
1. Expansion Site — visible on Command Map, not claimed.
2. Claimed Site — reserved for you.
3. Seed Ark en route — fleet carries Seed Ark.
4. Frontier Outpost — limited production; **not a colony**.
5. Colony — all establishment milestones complete.
6. Strategic World — evolution complete, specialization chosen.

**Establishment milestones (all four):** habitat, stable energy, communications hub, first population.

**First expansion gates:** Genesis Ark **development stage 5** and **Interstellar Expansion** tech level 1 — read from the Ark.

The **Genesis Ark** stays irreplaceable for account research and imperial systems.

**Practical flow (first expansion):**
1. Ark at **stage 5** + **Interstellar Expansion** tier 1.
2. **Command Map** (`/galaxy`, world map) — Expansion Site visible.
3. **Claim** site, prepare **Seed Ark** at shipyard.
4. **Fleet** → colonize mission with Seed Ark to the site.
5. **Frontier Outpost** appears — complete establishment checklist.
6. After all milestones: full **colony** with DNA and full gameplay depth.

codex_expansion_tip_1: Watch checklist on outpost and Command Map.

codex_galaxy_quick_help: The **galaxy** shows your realm in space: **world map** (Command Map) with empire and expansion — plus classic **system view** for slots and fleet prefill.
codex_galaxy_summary: Coordinates `[G:S:P]` stay internal; players see **places**, **regions**, and **influence**. `/galaxy` has **world map** (default) and **classic system view** (15 slots + expedition slot).
codex_galaxy_why: The galaxy links discovery, expansion, and fleets. The world map makes growth visible; system view remains legacy bridge and fleet helper.
codex_galaxy_how_it_works:
- **World map:** Ark hub, colonies with roles, Expansion Sites, Strategic Worlds, chokepoints — actions depend on development stage and gates.
- **System view:** 15 positions; empty slots → colonize via fleet; slot 16 = expedition.
- Navigation remembers tab; coordinates often follow **active planet**.
- Fleet prefill from galaxy links.
- **`/empire`** is **not** the Command Map — it is the economy matrix.

codex_galaxy_tip_1: Active planet marks the slot in system view.
codex_galaxy_tip_2: Expedition slot is not a normal colony planet.
codex_fleet_quick_help: Fleets connect your worlds: transport, Seed Ark colonization, expeditions, attack, and logistics — ships from the **origin world**, slots via navigation tech.
codex_fleet_summary: Fleet system: **ships per world**, **movements empire-wide**, missions on arrival. Ships built at **orbital shipyard**. Fleet slots expanded by **navigation tech**.
codex_fleet_why: Without fleets: no expansion (Seed Ark), no logistics, no expeditions, no PvP. Fleets are the **operational hand** — targets are **places** and coordinates.
codex_fleet_how_it_works:
- Build ships at **orbital shipyard** on the departure world.
- **Fleet page:** select ships, mission, target (colony, map world, coordinates).
- Missions: transport, logistics, deploy, spy, attack, hold, expedition, colonize, recycle.
- **Colonization:** colonize mission with Seed Ark → outpost phase.
- **Expedition:** event on arrival — reports in messages.
- **Logistics** (`/logistics`): collect/distribute between your worlds.
- Flight time and fuel: server preview only.
- Ship stats: ship detail / Technical Data — not Codex.

codex_fleet_faq_1_a: Overview and Fleet show **all** movements — not only the active world.
codex_fleet_tip_0: Match fleet origin with active planet — ships are planet-bound.
codex_fleet_tip_1: Prioritize navigation tech for more parallel fleets.
codex_fleet_tip_2: Expedition: expo hulls for finds; cargo ships for salvage capacity.
codex_combat_quick_help: Combat happens when an **attack** fleet reaches a defended world: fleet vs. hangar and planetary defense — reports for both sides.
codex_combat_summary: **Round-based combat** (up to six rounds): attacker fleet vs. defender hangar and **stationary defense**. Outcome: losses, debris, optional plunder, inbox reports. Research modifies combat values.
codex_combat_why: PvP and colony risk need server-side resolution. Combat links fleet, defense, research, and ranking.
codex_combat_how_it_works:
- Send **attack** from the Fleet page (PvP rules apply).
- Pick targets via quick target, coordinates, or galaxy link — server computes flight and fuel.
- On arrival: simulation → losses on fleet, hangar, defense.
- **Attacker wins:** plunder up to return cargo; credited on return (not at target).
- **Debris field** at target — visible in galaxy system view; recycle mission harvests.
- Both players get **combat reports** in messages (rounds, losses, outcome).
- **Stationary defense** and **hangar ships** fight together — hangar alone is not enough.
- Combat techs modify values empire-wide.
- Formulas: ship/defense detail and Technical Data — not Codex.

codex_defense_quick_help: Planetary **defense** protects the active world: stationary guns and barriers from the defense factory — not orbiting fleets.
codex_defense_summary: **Stationary units per colony**: built via defense factory and defense queue. Live UI at `/defense`. On **attack**, hangar ships and defense fight together. Empire **defense score** for ranking.
codex_defense_why: Fleets alone are not enough — colonies need local defense. Defense is **stationary** (planet) vs. **mobile** (fleet), and feeds combat and spy intel.
codex_defense_how_it_works:
- Build **defense factory** on the world to protect.
- Open **Defense** — queue units (requirements from buildings and account research).
- Turrets and barriers unlock with factory level and techs.
- Stock is **planet-bound** like hangar ships.
- Header switcher changes defense view.
- Combat values in defense detail / Technical Data — not Codex.
